name: MemFlow
provider: self-hosted (The University of Hong Kong, Kling Team)
model_version: MemFlow base.pt (generator) + lora.pt (rank 256; chunk-wise AR, 4-step, no CFG, memory bank) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code KlingAIResearch/MemFlow@7ed514771f5a (configs/interactive_inference.yaml)

weights.repo: KlingTeam/MemFlow@c41043fd (base.pt, lora.pt) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

license: Apache-2.0 (repository); LongLive-derived source files carry CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 headers; weights: no licence stated on the model card
notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps, 3-latent (12-frame) causal blocks generated live with upstream interactive_inference.yaml settings (4 warped steps, local attention 12 latents, sink 3 with global sink, memory bank 3 frames updated every 9 latents, sparse memory activation off as released). Prompt changes use upstream's interactive switch (cross-attention reset + KV re-cache of the last 12 latents under the new prompt). The block prompt is '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>'; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input. Temporal RoPE table extended from 1024 to 4096 positions (same formula) for 300-second sessions.
